WITH actor_counts AS (
  SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY actor_id
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(film_count) AS total FROM actor_counts
),
actor_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ac.actor_id,
    ac.film_count,
    CAST(ac.film_count AS FLOAT) / tc.total AS actor_share
  FROM actor_counts ac
  CROSS JOIN total_count tc
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(actor_share) AS avg_actor_share
  FROM actor_shares
),
with_diff AS (
  SELECT
    als.actor_id,
    als.film_count,
    als.actor_share,
    als.actor_share - avgsh.avg_actor_share AS share_diff
  FROM actor_shares als
  CROSS JOIN avg_share avgsh
)
SELECT 
  actor_id,
  film_count,
  actor_share,
  share_diff
FROM with_diff
ORDER BY share_diff DESC
LIMIT 10
